svg.title: Ila calls an emergency public review by lantern light.
svg.desc: The dead smart table sits in darkness while an old records cabinet supports lanterns, Cecil's blue light and Ila's open ledger. Staff and affected residents gather as Ila invokes the trial-review clause.
